speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help understand your symptoms of inappropriate behavior and weight changes, when did you first notice these changes, and have you experienced any headaches or vision problems recently?

text: 55-year-old male. The patient has demonstrated inappropriate behavior, including making unfitting comments and attempts to kiss strangers, over the past 6 months. speaker: Doctor
text: Those changes in personality and specific dietary cravings, particularly for carbohydrates, are very telling. Have you noticed any changes in your sense of smell or any memory lapses, and do you have a history of high cholesterol or diabetes?

text: My main symptom is Inappropriate behavior. I also have Disinterest in family interactions, Craving for specific foods, Significant weight gain, Apathy, Blunted affect.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the combination of personality changes, hyperphagia, and weight gain, I suspect a frontal lobe issue. REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal MRI is surprising given the classic symptoms, so I need to rule out other causes. Have you experienced any recent head trauma, seizures, or changes in your sexual behavior or libido?

speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal MRI effectively rules out large tumors or strokes, but these symptoms—particularly the hyperphagia, weight gain, and personality changes—are classic for frontal lobe degeneration like frontotemporal dementia.
